verses.en: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.
verses.sm: Aperamo nai Aikupito, o ia, ma lana avà, ma ana mea uma, 0 Lota foi taatasi ma ia, e o i le itu i toga.

verses.en: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
verses.sm: Ua mauoa tele lava Aperamo i manu, ma ario, ma auro.

verses.en: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth-el, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Beth-el and Hai;
verses.sm: Ua alu foi o ia i lana malaga nai le itu i toga ua oo i Peteli, i le mea lava sa muai i ai lona fale ie, i le va o Peteli ma Ai;

verses.en: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.
verses.sm: 0 le mea na i ai le fata faitaulaga sa na muai faia i lea mea; ua valaau atu ai foi Aperamo i le suafa o le ALII.

verses.en: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
verses.sm: O Lota foi, sa la o ma Aperamo, sa ia te ia o mamoe, ma povi, ma fale ie.

verses.en: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
verses.sm: Ua le mafai lava ona la mau faatasi i le nuu, aua sa tele lava a laua mea, ua le mafai ai ona la mau faatasi.

verses.en: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.
verses.sm: Ua femisai foi leoleo o manu a Aperamo ma leoleo o manu a Lota; o ona po foi ia sa mau ai sa Kanana ma sa Perisé ile nuu.

verses.en: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Aperamo ia Lota, Aua lava neʻi femisa‘i i taua, po O a taua leoleo manu; ana o le uso i taua.

verses.en: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
verses.sm: E le o i ou luma ea le laueleele uma? Seʻi e te“a ese ma aʻu. Afai e te alu i le itu tauagavale, ona ou alu ai lea i le itu taumatau; a E alu i le itu taumatau, ona ou alu ai lea i le itu tauagavale.

verses.en: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.
verses.sm: Ua vaavaai Lota, ona iloa atu ai lea e ia i le fanua laugatasi uma ua i ai Ioritana, ua lafulemu uma lava, e 00 Soara, e pei o le faatoaga a le ALII, e pei o le laueleele o Aikupito, a o lei faaumatia e le ALII o Sotoma ma Komoro.

verses.en: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
verses.sm: Ona filifilia lea e Lota mona o le fanua laugatasi uma ua i ai loritana; ua aga‘i atu foi Lota i sasa‘e; ona la te'a eseese ai lea o le tasi ma le tasi.

verses.en: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
verses.sm: Ua mau Aperamo i le nuu o Kanana, a o Lota ua mau ia i aai o le fanua laugatasi, ma ua faatuina ai lona fale ie, ua oo atu i Sotoma.

verses.en: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.
verses.sm: A o tagata o Sotoma ua leaga i latou, ma ua matua agasala lava i luma o le Aw.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu foi le ALI ia Aperamo, ina ua ie“a eseese o Lota ma ia, Seʻi e vaavaai ia, ma iloa atu i le mea e te i ai na, i le itu i matu, ma le itu i toga, ma sasa'e, ma sisifo;

verses.en: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
verses.sm: aua o le laueleele uma ua e iloa atu nei, ou te foaiina atu mo oe ma lau fanau e faavavau.

verses.en: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.
verses.sm: Ou te faia foi lau fanau e pei o le efuefu o le eleele; afai e mafaia e se tagata ona faitauina o le efuefu o le eleele, ona mafai lea ona faitaulia o lau lava fanau.

verses.en: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.
verses.sm: Ina tulai ia, ina fealualuai i le nuu i lona umi ma lona lautele; auā ou te foaiinaatua mo oe.

verses.en: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.
verses.sm: Ona ave lea e Aperamo lona fale ie, ua alu atu ua mau i aluna o Mamere, o i Heperona lea, ua ia faia foi i lea mea le fata faitaulaga i le ALII.
